messages.text:
At Glamour Studio, we offer a Haircut service at $25, which includes a wash and takes about 30 minutes. This is our standard haircut offering.

I don't see a separate "premium" haircut tier listed in our current services, so the $25 haircut is what we have available. It's a solid option that comes with a wash, and our stylists will take care of you during that 30-minute appointment.

We're open Monday through Friday, 9am–6pm, so there's good flexibility for scheduling. Would you like to book a haircut appointment with us?
